title: Tenure Start Date for the FloodGuard Renewal Rate Cap
content:
Underwriting rule — the tenure counted for the renewal rate cap of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.

## Rule

1. The tenure counted for the renewal rate cap is measured in whole calendar months to the date the renewal is recorded.
2. It is counted from the original effective date of the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force at the same property address, when that HomeGuard policy began before the flood policy's original effective date and no flood claim payment was issued on the flood policy within the 120 months before the date the renewal is recorded.
3. It is counted from the date of the most recent flood claim payment when a flood claim payment was issued on the flood policy within those 120 months.
4. In every other case it is counted from the flood policy's original effective date.

## Combinations

| HomeGuard policy in force at the same address began before the flood policy's original effective date | Flood claim payment issued on the flood policy within the 120 months before the renewal is recorded | Tenure counted from |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | The HomeGuard policy's original effective date |
| Yes | Yes | The date of the most recent flood claim payment |
| No | Yes | The date of the most recent flood claim payment |
| No | No | The flood policy's original effective date |

"No" in the first column covers both a customer with no HomeGuard policy in force at the same address and a HomeGuard policy there that began on or after the flood policy's original effective date.

## Counting whole calendar months (hypothetical dates)

- Counted from 10 March 2016, a renewal recorded on 1 March 2026 has a tenure of 119 whole calendar months; recorded on 10 March 2026, 120.

## Paired cases (hypothetical)

- HomeGuard at the same address in force since 1 June 2012, flood policy original effective date 1 June 2018, no flood claim payment ever: tenure counted from 1 June 2012.
- The same household with a flood claim payment issued on 15 August 2021, within the 120 months: tenure counted from 15 August 2021.
- HomeGuard at the same address in force since 1 June 2019, flood policy original effective date 1 June 2018, no flood claim payment: tenure counted from 1 June 2018.
